message.content: Aisling expressed enthusiasm for using traps in "Octopath Traveler." She mentioned that traps are a game-changer, adding a strategic element to battles. This is evident in her statement, "Traps are such a game changer! I’ve set up a few ambushes that worked out really well. I love the strategy it adds to the battles!" Additionally, she shared her experience of setting up ambushes successfully, indicating that she has had success with using traps strategically to gain an advantage in battles.
